correctness.rationale: All 196226 nonempty independent simplices are generated exactly once from the graph adjacency. The 98087 matched pairs are disjoint and the full 1457216-arrow Hasse graph topologically sorts, certifying acyclicity. Signed unit cancellations give a 24x27 integer Morse boundary of exact rank 21 with a determinant -1 maximal-rank minor. Hence all 21 nonzero Smith factors are units, the reduced integral Betti ranks are three in degree four and six in degree five, and the 4/5-cell CW model admits the stated wedge-of-spheres reduction. Reproduced using included standard-library checker.

Its complete integral homotopy type is not determined by the published two-degree/Moore-space alternative; an explicit 196226-face acyclic matching and rank-21 unimodular integer boundary remove that ambiguity. The self-contained finite classification supplies a natural torsion-free data point and an exact reference for testing color/length recurrences, without pretending to settle the general conjecture.
